description: This file defines the EventBuffer class, which manages a buffer of virtio_input_event structures used for input event handling in the Cuttlefish project. It includes methods to add events, retrieve buffer size, and access raw data.

classes.name: EventBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a buffer of input events, allowing addition of events and access to the underlying data.

methods.name: EventBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a specified number of events.

methods.name: AddEvent
methods.description: Adds an input event with specified type, code, and value to the buffer.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer in bytes.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the raw data of the buffer.
